en-US.name: SendPalm
en-US.subtitle: Calm email, calendar & people
en-US.description:
SendPalm is a calm place to deal with email. Mail from people you know lands in one Imbox; everything else waits in the Screener until you decide what it is. No badges shouting at you, no threading you have to untangle — just the mail that matters, and the people behind it.

DESIGNED TO BE QUIET
• The Imbox, not the inbox. Mail from people stays in one list; newsletters and cold outreach go to the Paper Trail and the Screener instead of interrupting you.
• Bundles fold a chatty sender into one row. Three or more unread from the same person become a single line you can open when you want.
• Piles instead of snooze tricks: Reply Later, Set Aside, and Bubble Up put a mail where you will actually see it again.
• Read Together reads your unread mail one card at a time, focused reply keeps one conversation on screen.

EVERY MAILBOX, ONE PLACE
• Any IMAP account: iCloud, Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, Fastmail, Feishu, QQ, 163 and 126 — including the app-specific passwords and authorization codes those providers require.
• Several accounts merge into one Imbox; a tab narrows to a single mailbox whenever you want.
• Real IMAP sync in the background, with attachments, clickable links, and remote images held back until you ask for them.

PEOPLE, NOT ADDRESSES
• Every sender becomes a contact with their mail, files and meetings in one place.
• Insights show who you actually talk to and who has gone quiet.
• Calendar invites in the mail become events automatically, with a reply you can send from the event.

AN AGENT THAT WORKS IN YOUR MAIL
• Connect Claude Code, Codex or any MCP client over a local gateway: let it read your mail, draft replies, search, and — if you allow it — send.
• Every action it takes is written to an audit log you can read.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• Local-first: mail is stored on your device in SQLite. Nothing is uploaded to us; there is no SendPalm server and no account to create.
• Passwords live in the system keychain.
• Your AI provider is the one you configure — bring your own key.

SendPalm is a mail client for people who want to be done with mail, not live in it.
en-US.promotionalText: A calm mail client: one Imbox for people, a Screener for everyone else, bundles that fold a chatty sender into one row, and an agent that can actually work in your mail.

zh-Hans.name: SendPalm 邮件
zh-Hans.subtitle: 安静的邮件、日历与人脉
zh-Hans.description:
SendPalm 是一个让你安静处理邮件的地方。认识的人寄来的邮件进「收件箱」，其余的先进「筛选台」，等你决定它是什么。没有催命的小红点，也不需要你去理清一串串会话——只剩真正要紧的信，和信后面的人。

【为「安静」而设计】
• 收件箱只管人：人的邮件留在一条列表里；订阅与冷推销进「单据」和「筛选台」，不再打断你。
• 同一发件人三封以上未读会自动折叠成一行（bundle），想读时展开即可。
• 用「稍后回复」「已搁置」「气泡提醒」取代假装的稍后处理——邮件会回到你真会看到的位置。
• 「一起读」一封一封读未读邮件，「专注回复」把一段对话留在屏幕中间。

【多个邮箱，一个地方】
• 任何 IMAP 邮箱：iCloud、Gmail、Outlook、Yahoo、Fastmail、飞书、QQ、163、126——包括这些服务商要求的专用密码与授权码。
• 多个账户合并进同一个收件箱；想看单个邮箱时切一个标签就行。
• 后台真 IMAP 同步，附件、可点击链接都在，外部图片默认不加载。

【是人，不是地址】
• 每个发件人都是一个联系人：他的邮件、文件、会议都在一处。
• 「洞察」告诉你真正在联系谁、谁已经安静了。
• 邮件里的日程邀请自动变成日历事件，可以直接在事件里回复。

【一个真的能干活的 Agent】
• 通过本地网关接入 Claude Code、Codex 或任何 MCP 客户端：读信、起草回复、搜索，你允许的话还能直接发信。
• 它的每一次操作都写进审计日志，你可以翻。

【数据是你的】
• 本地优先：邮件以 SQLite 存在你自己的设备上，我们不上传、也没有 SendPalm 服务器、不用注册账号。
• 密码放在系统钥匙串里。
• AI 用你自己配置的服务商，密钥也由你自己保管。

SendPalm 给那些想「处理完邮件就走」的人，而不是住在收件箱里的人。
zh-Hans.keywords: 邮件,邮箱,IMAP,日历,联系人,收件箱,订阅,筛选,效率,AI,agent
zh-Hans.promotionalText: 安静的邮件客户端：人的邮件进一个收件箱，其余先过筛选台；同一发件人自动折叠；还能让 Agent 真的在邮件里干活。
